mechanism: Four-layer memory for long workflows plus RAG over domain library source code
evidence_scope: MatClaw uses a four-layer memory architecture that pre- vents progressive context loss, and retrieval-augmented generation over domain source code that raises per-step API-call accuracy to ∼99%.
evidence_role: We present MatClaw, acode-firstagent that writes and executes Python directly, composing any installed domain library
